messages.cognia.import.guide-limits: Preserves Markdown, folders and attachments. Database relations, query views, block references and dynamic plugins are not reconstructed. Convert ENEX, JEX, .sy, SQLite and OneNote formats first; skipped files show a reason.
messages.cognia.import.guide-tools: Obsidian and Logseq file graphs: choose the Markdown folder. Notion: export Markdown and CSV, then unzip. Joplin: export Markdown + Front Matter. SiYuan, Anytype, Bear, Apple Notes and Logseq DB: export Markdown first. LLM Wiki is a knowledge workflow, not a proprietary format.
